targets.name: intermetallic_fraction
targets.wording: equilibrium mole fraction, at 1273 K, of all phases other than liquid and the disordered fcc, bcc and hcp solid solutions (that is: sigma, Laves and other intermetallic phases, and ordered B2 or L12)
